questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is a quasar?
A. A type of interstellar gas cloud
B. A dense remnant of a massive star
C. An extremely bright and distant celestial object
Answer: C. Quasars are powered by supermassive black holes. They are so bright that if every individual were as luminous as the sun, a quasar would outshine the combined brightness of all humans by tens of thousands of times.
questions.de: Wie nennt man die extrem hellen, weit entfernten aktiven Galaxienkerne, die von supermassereichen Schwarzen Löchern angetrieben werden?
questions.en: What name is given to the extremely bright, distant active galactic nuclei powered by supermassive black holes?

timeline.labelEn: Allan Sandage and Thomas Matthews identify the radio source 3C 48 with a star-like optical object, the first quasar identification
timeline.labelDe: Allan Sandage und Thomas Matthews ordnen die Radioquelle 3C 48 einem sternartigen Objekt zu, die erste Identifizierung eines Quasars

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed. Its brightness explanation is garbled (comparing to 'all humans' as if each shone like the Sun); per Wikipedia the most powerful quasars are thousands of times more luminous than a whole galaxy such as the Milky Way.

questions.cardText:
[Art History] What is the “Baroque” period in art known for?
A. Minimalist and abstract designs
B. Dramatic, detailed, and exuberant style
C. Geometric shapes and bold colors
Answer: B. This style originated in early 17th-century Rome and is known to emphasize grandeur and emotional intensity.
questions.de: Welcher dramatische, überschwänglich detailreiche Kunststil, der Pracht und Gefühl betont, entstand zu Beginn des 17. Jahrhunderts in Rom?
questions.en: Which dramatic, exuberantly detailed style of art, emphasising grandeur and emotion, began in Rome at the start of the 17th century?

timeline.labelEn: The Baroque style flourishes in European art, from its start in Rome around 1600 until about 1750
timeline.labelDe: Der Barock prägt die europäische Kunst, von seinen Anfängen in Rom um 1600 bis etwa 1750

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed (style began at the start of the 17th century in Rome; contrast, movement, exuberant detail, grandeur).
